name: popsicle
headline: influencer.dev: Developer Influencer Marketplace
short_description: influencer.dev is a marketplace connecting developer-focused content creators with companies and brands seeking tech-savvy influencers for their campaigns.
author: zevireinitz

sections.overview:
influencer.dev is a directory and marketplace purpose-built for developer-focused content creators and the companies that want to work with them. It serves two audiences: creators who want to showcase their work and audience to potential brand partners, and companies or brands looking to find content creators that fit their developer-marketing needs. The project is hosted as a GitHub Pages site and accepts new creator submissions via a GitHub issue application form. By centralizing developer influencer profiles in one place, it removes the friction of sourcing and vetting technical content creators for developer-tool marketing campaigns.
Brands finding developer-focused content creators for product promotions
Developer influencers submitting their profiles to get discovered by companies
Marketing teams sourcing technical creators for developer tool campaigns
Companies browsing a curated directory of dev-content creators by niche or audience
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/zevireinitz/influencer.dev`
sections.usage:
```
I'm looking to find influencers in the [INDUSTRY] space who can create content around [TOPIC]. Can you suggest 5-10 influencers with their follower counts, engagement rates, and content examples?
```
